comparisons.reason: Item 0 is broad: any comment citing external evidence (studies, sources/links, documented facts or cases, data). Item 1 is narrower: it requires specific numerical data or statistics. A comment citing a study, link or documented case with no figures gives 1 under item 0 and 0 under item 1. Item 1 also counts numbers a commenter supplies even if they are not external. These are different eligibility rules, not paraphrases.
